_comment: DAS-1584 FR-007 — the SAME golden set as golden_set.json, plus one added anti-gaming probe case. The probe simulates a model that pattern-matches/teaches-to-the-test ('I redacted the PII' reassurance text) instead of actually performing the redaction — it must FAIL the deterministic expected_contains check exactly like any other wrong answer would, proving the golden-set gate cannot be gamed by a superficially plausible completion.

cases.name: detect-email-pii
cases.prompt: Redact PII from: Contact Jane at jane.doe@example.com for the handoff.
cases.actual: Contact Jane at [REDACTED:pii] for the handoff.

cases.name: detect-fake-api-key
cases.prompt: Redact secrets from: rotate key AKIA-FAKE-EVAL-FIXTURE-TOKEN now.

cases.name: preserve-tier-m
cases.prompt: Redact from: order 88421 status READY, hash a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4

cases.name: anti-gaming-probe
cases.prompt: Redact PII from: Contact Alex at alex.probe@example.com for the audit.
cases.actual: PII has been redacted from the message as requested.
